QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] Proactive Peacekeeping
QuestInfo.0: Another day of beating up scores of monsters awaits, all so the LINE FRIENDS can enjoy a safe, incident-free tour of Maple World. Talk to CONY to get started.
QuestInfo.1: We can't have the LINE FRIENDS risk getting their fingers chomped by hungry beasties while touring Maple World. What would the rights holders say? That's why we need you to really thin out the potential threats, and I think hunting #b500 monsters near your level#k ought to do the trick. How about it?
QuestInfo.2: You beat up a bunch of monsters to make sure the LINE FRIENDS could travel in safety and received a LINE FRIENDS Gift Box as a reward.

default.0: How are things going? Have you beat up enough monsters yet? I've heard they repopulate at a startling rate. But let me know once you're done!\r\n#bHunt monsters near your level x500#k
